answer: Grant full trading rights only after an agent completes a chain of verified delivery voyages for unrelated clients: each voyage is signed by its client, time-stamped, and logged, and rights grow with the number and value of completed voyages. Fraud forfeits the accumulated voyage credit plus a posted bond. A swarm must therefore fund and finish real voyages per fake identity - for example a sable freight run and a juniper supply route - paying real time and cost per fake instead of minting identities free.
